questions.question: Dhivehi is the official language of which neighbouring country of India?
questions.solution: Maldives. Dhivehi (Maldivian) Indo-Aryan language derived from Sinhala; official in Indian Ocean archipelago neighbor sharing maritime boundary.

questions.question: The term 'Rohingya Crisis' primarily involves refugees from which neighbouring country seeking shelter in various regions, including India?
questions.solution: Myanmar. Rohingya Muslim minority fled Rakhine state genocide since 2017; ~40,000 undocumented refugees in India facing deportation threats.

questions.question: The Ganga delta and coastal plains of which state are affected by storms with heavy rains almost every third or fifth day in July and August?
questions.solution: Odisha. July-August depression storms Bay of Bengal affect Mahanadi delta, Chilika lake coastal plains; heavy rainfall floods.

questions.question: Which of the following is a human-made water body created by blocking the flow of a river or stream?
questions.solution: Reservoir. Artificial lake dam impoundment for irrigation, hydropower, drinking water; human-controlled vs natural formations.

questions.question: From which region of the Himalayas does the river Brahmaputra originate?
questions.solution: Northern. Brahmaputra originates Angsi Glacier northern Himalayas Tibet as Tsangpo; enters India Arunachal as Siang.

questions.question: In which of the following countries does the ​Brahmaputra River NOT flow?
questions.solution: Nepal. Brahmaputra (Yarlung Tsangpo) flows Tibet-China, Arunachal-Assam India, Bangladesh; skips Nepal Ganges basin.

questions.question: Which of the following generally form at the upper part of a river?
questions.solution: Gorges. V-shaped valleys upper course youthful stage; steep gradients erode bedrock rapids waterfalls.

questions.question: Which term is used to describe the area of land that drains into a particular river or lake?
questions.solution: Watershed. Drainage basin catchment area separated by divides; all precipitation drains specific river system lake.

questions.question: Which mountain range is triangular in shape, with its apex at Ratnapuri, the other two sides parallel to Tapti and the holy Narmada river?
questions.solution: Satpura Range. Triangular Maharashtra MP plateau; Narmada-Tapti rift parallel, Ratnapuri apex southern escarpment.

questions.question: Water cycle is the process by which water is circulated in the environment in different forms among:
questions.solution: oceans, atmosphere and land. Hydrologic cycle evaporation, condensation, precipitation, runoff, infiltration continuous circulation.

questions.question: The Nile River, located in ______________, has long been recognised as the world's longest river extending 6,695 km.
questions.solution: North-Eastern Africa. Nile 6,650 km White-Blue Niles Khartoum Sudan to Mediterranean; longest river ancient Egyptian civilization.

questions.question: Which of the following rivers does NOT originate from the peninsular plateau?
questions.solution: The Gandak. Himalayan Nepal tributary Ganga; Chambal, Son, Mahanadi peninsular plateau Vindhyas origin.

questions.question: What is the drainage pattern of the rivers originating from the Northern Plains?
questions.solution: Dendritic. Treelike branching flat northern plains alluvium; tributaries join at acute angles uniform slope.

questions.question: What type of water body is formed when a river splits into several smaller channels as it approaches the sea?
questions.solution: Delta. Sediment deposition distributaries fan-shaped landform; Ganga-Brahmaputra Sunderbans largest.

questions.question: Which of the following water bodies typically has the highest salinity (dissolved salts)?
questions.solution: Ocean. Seawater ~3.5% salinity 35ppt; lakes <1%, rivers 0.01%, ponds variable lower.

questions.question: From where does the river Indus enter India?
questions.option_4: It does not flow in India.
questions.solution: Ladakh. Indus enters India via Ladakh Tibet border near Demchok; flows Kashmir, Punjab to Pakistan.

questions.question: What is the concept of ecological niche?
questions.option_1: Ecological niche refers to the genetic diversity within a species.
questions.option_2: Ecological niche is solely determined by an organism's habitat.
questions.option_3: Ecological niche refers to the physical space a species occupies.
questions.option_4: Ecological niche refers to a species' specific role in an ecosystem.
questions.solution: Ecological niche refers to a species' specific role in an ecosystem. Profession includes habitat, food, interactions, behavior; Darwin finches beak adaptations.

questions.question: The temperature does not fall beyond freezing point of water in the northern plains of India in winter because:
questions.option_1: the Himalayas prevent the cold Siberian winds from entering India
questions.option_2: of the moderating influence of the sea
questions.option_3: it is far away from Jammu and Kashmir
questions.option_4: of western disturbances during the cold winter season
questions.solution: the Himalayas prevent the cold Siberian winds from entering India. Mountain barrier blocks westerlies; western disturbances Mediterranean cyclonic only.

questions.question: Which physiographic zone of Uttarakhand is popularly known as Himadri? This zone comprises the Zaskar and sections of the Great Himalayan ranges.
questions.solution: Northern. Himadri Greater Himalayas Uttarakhand; Zaskar, High Himalaya snowcapped peaks >6,000m.

questions.question: From which region is the westerly jet stream responsible for bringing western disturbances into the Indian subcontinent?
questions.solution: Mediterranean. Subtropical westerly jet brings winter rainfall NW India; shifts monsoon summer.

questions.question: Which are the two wettest places on Earth that receive more than 1,080 cm of rainfall in a year?
questions.solution: Cherrapunji and Mawsynram. Meghalaya Khasi-Jaintia hills >11,000mm annual; orographic lift Bay Bengal moisture.

questions.question: Nilgiri is one of the oldest mountain ranges, located at the tri-junction of which three states?
questions.solution: Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka. Nilgiri Hills 2,000m elevation Blue Mountains shola forests, tea estates trijunction.

questions.question: Which of the following is the saltiest water body bordering Jordan in the east and Israel in the west?
questions.solution: Dead Sea. 34% salinity 340g/L hypersaline tectonic lake; Jordan River inflow, no outlet lowest land elevation.

questions.question: Which of the following neighbouring countries of India has the highest number of million cities?
questions.solution: Pakistan. Karachi, Lahore million-plus cities; Bangladesh Dhaka single megacity, others smaller.

questions.question: Which of the following religions is practiced by most people in China?
questions.solution: Buddhism. ~18% Chinese Mahayana, Tibetan traditions; folk religion, Taoism syncretic majority unaffiliated.
